limits: Automated geometry diagnostics are not independent verification of a crossing, its legality, operation or any closure.
Repeated-contact groups are review units and are not accepted counts of physical crossing facilities.
Country sides use this frozen OSM Uganda polygon; systematic boundary errors remain possible.
Outside Uganda is a geometric side, not independent proof of the neighbouring jurisdiction; tripoints and disputed segments need source review.
Thirty metres and the continuation distances are explicit review parameters, not measured positional accuracy.
Graph joins use shared OSM node IDs and separate transport modes; name/ref continuity guides endpoint branches.
Incomplete or ambiguous graph continuation stays unresolved; private/access restrictions require separate review.
Only original pilot candidates are diagnosed; this run does not discover missed crossings.
Original 75 m groups are retained for audit; nearby roads in one old group are not thereby one facility.
This equatorial single-country context selection has not validated antimeridian or global projection edge cases.
